newsitem.title: MEXICO: Leftist Mexican party calls for boycott of Afores.
newsitem.headline: Leftist Mexican party calls for boycott of Afores.

text.p: The congressional delegation of Mexico's left-leaning Party of the Democratic Revolution (PRD) on Sunday called on Mexican workers nationwide to boycott the private pension fund firms known as Afores.

The PRD group instead is urging Mexicans to stick with the government pension plan operated by the Mexican Social Security Institute (IMSS), accusing the private firms of an unscrupulous campaign to win over vulnerable workers.

"This (IMSS) account guarantees real returns for workers while the private Afores do not protect savings against the havoc of inflation," PRD Deputy Amado Cruz Malpica said in a statement issued by the party.
The PRD said it would propose legislation to form a separate, public, non-profit Afore program that will guarantee real returns.
The PRD warned workers against feeling obligated to sign up with any private pension fund, stressing that they still have the right to remain vested with the government plan.

Mexico privatized the pension fund system last year, leading to a massive advertising campaign by private pension fund firms, mostly operated by banks, to win over Mexican workers from the government plan.
